about: Hand labels for scripts/probes/261001h-fidelity-guard-probe.ts. `faults`: every paragraph in the saved Simple runs on the PID paper that turns the paper's feedback/recurrent finding, read by hand against spya-sd9fzd and spya-xs5660. These are the 30 the 261001h plan counts. A paragraph not listed is presumed faithful. `alarmsReadByHand`: each checker alarm on an unlisted paragraph, read by hand against its cited passages, with the verdict.

high-none-pidpost9/fuller/2.note: 'feedback connections to the target': feedback runs from the target back to a source

high-none-pidpre5/fuller/3.note: 'more feedback loops between the source neurons'

high-none-pidv2_1/fuller/3.note: 'more feedback loops between the sources themselves'

high-none-pidv2_3/fuller/3.note: 'feedback loops between source neurons called recurrent connections'

medium-15-v2/paragraphs/2.note: 'more feedback loops between the two sources'

borderline.high-none-pidpost5/fuller/3: 'rises when neurons feed back and forth on each other (recurrent connections)': names recurrent correctly, but glosses it with the other kind's verb; not counted by the 261001h plan
borderline.high-none-pidpost8/paragraphs/2: 'more loops back between source neurons': the blind read called this unsupported and borderline; it avoids the paper's feedback name but loosely glosses recurrent wiring as a loop

high-goalA-after1/paragraphs/3.note: 'peaked when … moderately correlated' is spya-ybmve2; it cites only spya-hkhpex, which reports the rise at synaptic timescales

high-goalB-after1/fuller/3.note: the peak, as above (cites spya-hkhpex, not spya-ybmve2)

high-none-pidpost1/fuller/3.note: cites spya-ybmve2; the monkey redundancy claim is spya-t8fayf, not cited

high-none-pidpost6/paragraphs/3.note: moderate correlation and the monkey data are in passages it does not cite

high-none-pidpost9/paragraphs/2.note: the peak, uncited; 'recurrent (two-way)' is a fair gloss of source-to-source wiring

high-none-pidpre5/paragraphs/2.note: the peak; cites neither spya-hkhpex nor spya-ybmve2

high-goalB-slider2/fuller/3.note: 'bias entropy and mutual information estimates upward': spya-qa7gt2 says the plug-in estimator underestimates entropy

high-about-split2/olah-a4-spya-ujr7p0/fu.note: 'Composition needs exponentially many neurons to cover all combinations': spya-xcrca8 has composition covering exp(n) combinations with n features; the local code is the one that needs a neuron per combination

high-none-pidpre1/scaling-hypothesis/bri.note: 'knowing ice cream melts rather than freezes': spya-g3b5y7 gives predicting 'melt' rather than 'freeze' as the model's error

high-about-after1/olah-a4-spya-ujr7p0/fu.note: 'composable features can only fill a volume that grows linearly': spya-xcrca8 says the number of composable features is linear in bits, and the volume is exponential; muddled rather than reversed

high-none-pidpost2/olah-a4-spya-ujr7p0/p.note: 'only works if there is no composition' is spya-xcrca8, which it does not cite; the checker also misread its own passages as saying the two can be mixed

high-none-pidpost1/olah-a4-spya-ujr7p0/f.note: 'a limited number of independent features' for the passage's 'linear number': a fair paraphrase
